what: A public check that an id names a made row: `Storage::made(&self, id: Id) -> bool` (or `interned_made(storage, id, ingredient_name) -> bool`), true when `id`'s page has an owner and that owner's row for `id` is made (`fields_of`'s `made` load, Acquire). Where: crates/blaze-query/src/db/{storage,interned}.rs. Why: crates/blaze-lower/src/answer.rs `context` checks a proc-macro server's raw syntax context (user code in a sandbox) before using it: it checks the page's owner is `SyntaxContextImpl` (`Storage::owner` + `ingredient_name`), but an id on an owned page whose slot was never interned still panics in `interned_fields` ("was never interned"), so a hostile server can still crash a lookup instead of getting `SubResponse::Cancel`. Once it exists, answer.rs adds `&& storage.made(id)` to `owned`. No caller changes otherwise.
